MLI.note: A judicial cybercrime pole and police brigade; not a national response body.

facts.fact: The Mali prosecutor's report says law no. 2022-058 of 22 December 2022 amending the Code of Penal Procedure gives the national cybercrime pole exclusive competence over offences in article 609 bis.
The national cybercrime pole reported for 2025 that 834 proceedings were under investigation out of 1,338 referrals, of which 208 were self-initiated and 1,130 complaints.
facts.system: Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité

MLI.note: Says the cybercrime pole has no application or software; no station record system.
